metas.name: Alam Flora bins
metas.note: Trash bins with this logo featuring a sunny landscape, saying ‘Alam Flora’ are found in Pahang, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya. The logo will occasionally be absent, and it will just say ‘Alam Flora’.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Black pole sticker
metas.note: Black pole stickers are only found on electricity poles in mainland Malaysia.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Johor street signs
metas.note: Yellow street name signs are specific to the state of Johor
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Leave bins
metas.note: Trash bins with a logo resembling leaves are found in Perlis and Kedah.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Mainland lamp post
metas.note: Lamp posts with two small circles or with a triangular support on the support are mainly found on mainland Malaysia.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Perlis rocks
metas.note: These isolated rock formations, rising abruptly from an otherwise flat landscape, can be found near the Thai border in Perlis state.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: S bins
metas.note: Trash bins with a logo resembling an ‘S’ are found in the states of Negeri Sembilan, Malacca and Johor.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Sabah mountain roads
metas.note: Assuming you are on Borneo: the state of Sabah is very mountainous, and much of the coverage is on mountain roads like this one.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Sabah pole top
metas.note: Thin metal poles with two parallel pole tops are exclusive to the Sabah region of Borneo.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Sabah street signs
metas.note: Green street signs that form an arrow shape and have a yellow hexagonal symbol with the letters JKR on the left side are found in Sabah.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Sarawak lamp posts
metas.note: This lamp post with a supporting piece of sheet metal resembling a boomerang is found in Sarawak.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.

metas.name: Sarawak pole top
metas.note: Sarawak exclusive poles have a 2-1 insulator configuration, and a long diagonal wooden support.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/malaysia.
